name: p8-passive-active
caption: Passive sensors record sunlight reflected by the ground, or heat the ground emits. Active sensors send their own pulse and time the echo: a laser for LiDAR, microwaves for radar.

name: p8-waveform
caption: A simulated full waveform for one footprint over tropical forest. Energy returns first from the top of the canopy, then from the lower layers, and last from the ground. RH98 is the height below which 98 % of the energy returned: the usual measure of canopy height.

name: p8-gedi-rh98
caption: Every coloured dot is a GEDI footprint track: a laser sample, not a map. Tall forest at the edge of the Sebangau peat swamp stands out against the city, the cleared and burned peat and the farmland around Palangka Raya.

df = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(DATA))

def plot_heights(df):
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 3.8))
    order = df.groupby("class").rh98.median().sort_values().index      # tallest at the top
    for i, c in enumerate(order):
        v = df[df["class"] == c].rh98
        ax.boxplot(v, positions=[i], widths=0.55, vert=False, showfliers=False,
                   medianprops=dict(color="#dc2626"))
        q1, q3 = v.quantile([0.25, 0.75])
        ax.text(min(q3 + 1.5 * (q3 - q1), v.max()) + 0.8, i, f"median {v.median():.0f} m, n = {len(v)}",
                va="center", fontsize=7.5)
    ax.set_yticks(range(len(order))); ax.set_yticklabels(order, fontsize=8.5)
    ax.set_xlabel("GEDI RH98 (m)")
    top = df[df["class"] == "Trees"].rh98.median()
    ax.set_title(f"GEDI separates forest (median {top:.0f} m) from the cleared and burned land around it",
                 loc="left", fontsize=10)
    for s in ("top", "right"):
        ax.spines[s].set_visible(False)
    return fig

plot_heights(df)
plt.show()

caption: LiDAR systems from drone to orbit. Figures are typical, not specifications.

| System           | Platform                | Wavelength (nm)   | Sampling                           | Coverage                  | Best for                                                      |
|:-----------------|:------------------------|:------------------|:-----------------------------------|:--------------------------|:--------------------------------------------------------------|
| Airborne (ALS)   | aircraft, 500-3000 m    | 1064 or 1550      | a few to tens of points per m²     | one survey area at a time | terrain, canopy, cities; about 10-15 cm vertical              |
| Drone (ULS)      | drone, 50-120 m         | 905 or 1550       | hundreds of points per m²          | a few km²                 | single trees, stockpiles, corridors                           |
| GEDI             | ISS, about 420 km       | 1064              | 25 m footprints along 8 tracks     | 51.6° N to 51.6° S, 2019- | canopy height and structure (paused March 2023 to April 2024) |
| ICESat-2 (ATLAS) | satellite, about 500 km | 532               | photon counting, shots 0.7 m apart | global, 2018-             | ice, sea ice, water level, terrain and canopy                 |
